name: TIMER RESOLUTION
description: Sets timer resolution to 0.5ms by disabling dynamic tick and using platform tick.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = bcdedit /enum {current} 2>&1; if ($r -match 'useplatformtick\s+Yes') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE GAME MODE
description: Enables Windows Game Mode to prioritize gaming performance.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name 'AutoGameModeEnabled' -ErrorAction Stop).AutoGameModeEnabled; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE HAGS
description: Enables Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling for lower latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'HwSchMode' -ErrorAction Stop).HwSchMode; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE FULLSCREEN OPTIMIZATIONS
description: Disables fullscreen optimizations for exclusive fullscreen in games.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode' -ErrorAction Stop).GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GAME DVR
description: Disables Game DVR and background recording to free up resources.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name 'AllowGameDVR' -ErrorAction Stop).AllowGameDVR; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE GAME BAR
description: Disables the Xbox Game Bar overlay and hotkeys.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameBar' -Name 'AllowGameBar' -ErrorAction Stop).AllowGameBar; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE MEMORY INTEGRITY
description: Disables Core Isolation Memory Integrity to reduce virtualization overhead.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity' -Name 'Enabled' -ErrorAction Stop).Enabled; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE VBS
description: Disables Virtualization-Based Security to reclaim CPU performance.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard' -Name 'EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE VRR
description: Enables Variable Refresh Rate for smoother gaming on supported displays.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name 'VariableRefreshRate' -ErrorAction Stop).VariableRefreshRate; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: OPTIMIZE GAMES
description: Disables the platform clock for lower timer resolution in games.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = bcdedit /enum {current} 2>&1; if ($r -match 'useplatformclock\s+No') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE MSI MODE
description: Enables Message Signaled Interrupts for all supported devices.
command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$devices = Get-PnpDevice -Class 'Display','Net' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($d in $devices) { $path = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\' + $d.InstanceId + '\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; if (Test-Path $path) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name 'MSISupported' -Value 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $d = Get-PnpDevice -Class 'Display' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $path = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\' + $d.InstanceId + '\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties'; $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $path -Name 'MSISupported' -ErrorAction Stop).MSISupported; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE HPET
description: Disables High Precision Event Timer and dynamic tick for lower latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = bcdedit /enum {current} 2>&1; if ($r -match 'useplatformclock\s+No') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE SPECTRE MELTDOWN
description: Disables Spectre and Meltdown CPU mitigations for maximum performance.
command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v FeatureSettingsOverride /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name 'FeatureSettingsOverride' -ErrorAction Stop).FeatureSettingsOverride; if ($v -eq 3) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE TPM
description: Disables Credential Guard and TPM-based security scenarios.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\CredentialGuard' -Name 'Enabled' -ErrorAction Stop).Enabled; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE PREFETCH
description: Disables the Windows Prefetcher to reduce disk activity.
command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters" /v EnablePrefetcher /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters' -Name 'EnablePrefetcher' -ErrorAction Stop).EnablePrefetcher; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
